errors.evidence: The description omits the sixth category, "Symptom", from the list of x-axis labels.

errors.text_span: 图表中存在五个柱状图
errors.evidence: The chart contains six bars, not five.

errors.text_span: “Operation” 柱状图的高度约为 12%，最高点在 12.5% 附近。“Time” 柱状图的高度约为 12.5%，最高点在 13% 附近。“Disease” 柱状图的高度约为 13.5%，最高点在 14% 附近。
errors.evidence: The values for these categories are all overstated. "Operation" and "Time" are at approximately 11%, and "Disease" is at approximately 12%.

errors.text_span: “Medicine” 柱状图的高度约为 18.5%，最高点略低于 19%
errors.evidence: The bar for "Medicine" has a height of approximately 12%. The description incorrectly assigns it the value of the "Examination" bar, which is approximately 19%.

errors.text_span: 而“Examination” 和 “Symptom” 柱状图均的高度约为 35%
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The bar for "Examination" is at approximately 19%. Only the "Symptom" bar is at 35%. The description incorrectly claims they are both at the same height.
